dedupe_keys.name: nile university campus power station demand and carbon data

description: The Energy Consumption Dataset contains demand and carbon-related records for Nile University of Nigeria’s first campus power station in Abuja. The research team obtained eight months of smart-meter information from a common busbar serving five campus blocks. The supply combines three diesel generators, utility electricity and photovoltaic generation. The producer describes weekly measurement collection; the short repository metadata do not establish exact observation dates or a uniform within-week interval. Mendeley version 3 lists two Excel workbooks and provides free CC BY 4.0 access. Coverage is limited to this power station, not the entire university or a regional electricity network. Carbon figures associated with the photovoltaic system require their original accounting definitions before comparison with measured emissions. A reviewer-assessed use is deriving campus-load and hybrid-supply assumptions for sizing simulations. model-pypsa is a related electricity-system optimization resource. Neither workbook was downloaded, and the dispatch arrangement was not reproduced.
